Leo is going to travel to Xi'an in July. Both of them like rice and tea. Max is interested in reading. Prices include tax already.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the meeting room by bike. The meeting room is one of the best places in the city. Leo usually has rice for breakfast. Local sponsorship funds the youth team.
Leo thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. The weather was snowy that day. Leo and Max had great fun there. For example, an eye test is free for kids.
Leo wants to be a nurse in the future. Leo wrote about the day in the diary. Leo learned a lot about science.
